summary.text: David Bullard is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 6 who took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Patrick Southerland as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Bullard assumed office on November 21, 2018; the June 16, 2026 Republican primary for his seat was canceled.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Tourism and Wildlife Committee and a member of the Administrative Rules, Energy, Senate Judiciary and Senate Rules committees.
